audit_item: A04 / research-ledger reconciler directory scan isolation
finding: Recursive report discovery did not install an explicit traversal error handler. A directory access failure could escape as an unstructured OS error, leaving callers without an explicit signal that the selected report set might be incomplete.
change: Replaced implicit Path.rglob traversal with deterministic os.walk using followlinks=false and an error callback. Any traversal error or symlink directory that would be skipped now raises a path-qualified ValueError before report parsing or ledger access, for both dry-run and apply.

verification.scan_failure_regression: Injected a subdirectory PermissionError and a directory symlink omitted by non-following traversal; dry-run and apply both fail closed before ledger access.
verification.mypy: mypy packages qa --follow-imports=silent: success, 225 source files.
verification.scope: Synthetic temporary report directory and temporary SQLite path only. No project registry, market archive, account data, Validation, Test, or Holdout payload was accessed.
